noun_definition: lhn refers to the left-hand navigation panel in the web application where users can access different sections, including "Your space."
Beginning refers to the initial message displayed in the chat interface that indicates the start of a conversation when accessing "Your space."
chat refers to a message displayed in the user interface indicating the start of a conversation or interaction within the application.
Message refers to the notification displayed in the user interface that states "This is the beginning of your chat" when a user pins "Your space" in the Left Hand Navigation (LHN).
space refers to a designated area or section within the application where user-specific content or interactions occur, indicated by the label "Your space."
